title: Patch: the game log's card buttons meet the 24-pixel target on a mouse too
thread:
**Issue #4296 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #4296: Patch: the game log's card buttons meet the 24-pixel target on a mouse too Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means On a computer, the lines of the game log that name a card are small click targets packed closer together than 24 pixels, so opening the card from the log needs precise aiming. After this change each card-naming log line is at least a 24-pixel target on a mouse while still looking like the same dense list; touch screens keep the 44-pixel rows they already have. Keyboard, screen-reader and log-history behaviour do not change. ## Why The client's own accessibility statement lists this as a known gap: with a mouse the card names in the game log sit closer together than 24 pixels, while on touch each line is 44 pixels tall. WCAG 2.2 success criterion 2.5.8 (Target Size Minimum, level AA, the level the statement checks at) asks for at least 24 by 24 pixels. The log is how a player re-reads what happened and opens the card it names (the line is a button that opens the inspect sheet), so the smallest targets sit on one of the most-clicked parts of the board, worst in long late-game logs. None of the open issues covers log target spacing, and none of the rejected suggestions does either: the nearby items are about a phone toggle badge for new lines, about the log holding its scroll position, and about naming cards, all different work. ## Proposal Give the log's card-name buttons a 24-pixel minimum target on fine pointers (minimum height and spacing on the button, keeping the inline dense-list look), leaving the coarse-pointer 44-pixel row rule exactly as it is. Hold it with a stylesheet unit test in the style of the existing CSS tests plus the existing axe/e2e coverage at a desktop size. No engine, server or spec rule changes: this is presentation only. ## Where it lands Files: `apps/web/src/game/inspectable.css` (the `.log .log-card` rule and its coarse-pointer 44-pixel row), `apps/web/src/game/board.css` (the `.log` / `.log-line` list styling), `apps/web/src/game/Log.tsx` (behaviour unchanged; the button it already draws), `apps/web/src/routes/accessibility.tsx` (the known-gaps bullet that documents this gap is removed). SPEC section: §10.10 (client rendering). Tests: a stylesheet/unit test next to the log tests (`apps/web/src/game/Log.test.tsx` area) and the existing axe and e2e board-measure specs. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] On a fine-pointer desktop width every card-naming log line exposes a hit target at least 24 pixels tall, verified by a unit/stylesheet test and by axe with no new violation. - [ ] On a coarse pointer each log line keeps its 44-pixel row. - [ ] The log still looks like the same dense list (no jump to full 44-pixel rows on desktop) and still scrolls inside its capped box with the newest line kept in view. - [ ] The accessibility page no longer lists the sub-24-pixel mouse spacing as a known gap. - [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test` on the touched test files, `cargo fmt --check`, and the web typecheck/lint gates pass. ## Size and risks Small: two stylesheets plus tests and one bullet of copy, a day or less of bot work. Main risk is the desktop log growing slightly taller per card line; it is bounded by the log's existing capped height with scrolling, and the change keeps the inline layout rather than switching desktop to the roomy touch rows (the rejected alternative: 44 pixels everywhere, which would break the dense desktop list). --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it. Area: `client` (`suggestions.areas`). Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it. ## Plan _Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44749837223)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal Give every card-naming game-log line a hit target at least 24 pixels tall on a fine pointer (mouse), while the log still reads as the same dense inline list and still scrolls inside its capped box with the newest line kept in view. Keep the coarse-pointer 44-pixel row rule exactly as it is, keep keyboard, screen-reader and log-history behavior unchanged, and remove the sub-24-pixel mouse-spacing bullet from the accessibility statement. No engine, server or spec rule changes: this is presentation only under §10.10. ## Files to touch | File | New / change | What changes there | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/game/inspectable.css` | change | New `@media (pointer: fine)` block: `.log .log-card` becomes `inline-block` with `min-height: 24px`, placed after the base rule and before the coarse-pointer block, with a short comment citing WCAG 2.5.8 | | `apps/web/src/game/Log.test.tsx` | change | New `describe` with two stylesheet-text tests (fine-pointer 24px rule present as specified; coarse-pointer 44px rule still present verbatim), using `readSheet` from `src/test/setup.ts` | | `apps/web/src/routes/accessibility.tsx` | change | Delete the single Known-gaps `
  • ` bullet beginning `"With a mouse, the card names in the game log are closer together than 24 pixels` (line 72) | | `apps/web/static-pages.ts` | change | Delete the matching `
  • With a mouse, the card names in the game log…` string in the `PAGE_TEXT` Known-gaps section (the word-for-word quote test requires route and `PAGE_TEXT` to match) | | `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | Delete the orphaned translation entry for the removed bullet (the `"With a mouse, the card names…"` key) | Read but do not edit: `apps/web/src/game/board.css` (verify `.log` capped box with `overflow-y: auto` and `.log-line` styling unchanged), `apps/web/src/game/Log.tsx` (the `.log-card` button it draws is unchanged), `spec/10-engine-guide.md` §10.10 (the log paragraph; presentation only, CLAUDE.md rule 7). Must not touch: anything under `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `crates/`, `apps/edge/`, `e2e/`, or `spec/` (no ruling: rule 3 needs none since this makes no rules decision). Governing spec section: §10.10 (client rendering; the log keeps the whole game, presentation only). ## Steps 1. In `apps/web/src/game/inspectable.css`, insert the fine-pointer block between the base `.log .log-card` rule (lines 37–56) and the coarse-pointer block (lines 73–82). Copy this exactly: ```css /* WCAG 2.5.8: with a mouse each card-naming line is a 24 px target, still an inline dense-list line: the button keeps its inline look, only taller. Touch keeps its 44 px row in the block below. */ @media (pointer: fine) { .log .log-card { display: inline-block; min-height: 24px; } } ``` Do not touch the `@media (pointer: coarse)` block. Rationale for the exact properties: the base rule sets `display: inline`, on which `min-height` has no reliable effect, so `inline-block` is required for the button itself to reach 24 px; it wraps internally so long lines still read as the same lines. `min-height` (not padding or margin) forces each card line's row pitch to at least 24 px while plain non-card lines stay dense, which is the requirement. No named constant is added: the file's existing 44 px values are hardcoded and `index.css` already owns the `--hit-min` token pattern for CSS, so follow that precedent and add nothing to `apps/web/src/game/config.ts`. 2. In `apps/web/src/game/Log.test.tsx`, add `import { readSheet } from "../test/setup.ts";` (the helper `Board.test.tsx` and `Clock.test.tsx` use) and append a new `describe` block at the end of the file, following the `Clock.test.tsx` stylesheet-text assertion style (normalize nothing; assert on raw substrings): - `it("with a mouse each card-naming log line is a 24px target while the list stays inline", ...)` asserting the `inspectable.css` text contains `@media (pointer: fine)` and, within that block, `.log .log-card` with both `display: inline-block;` and `min-height: 24px;`, and that the base rule still contains `display: inline;` (the dense-list look for the fallback). - `it("on a touch screen each log line keeps its 44px row", ...)` asserting the text still contains the unchanged `@media (pointer: coarse)` block with `.log .log-card`, `display: flex;` and `min-height: 44px;` verbatim. 3. In `apps/web/src/routes/accessibility.tsx`, delete line 72, the whole `
  • {t("With a mouse, the card names in the game log are closer together than 24 pixels; on a touch screen each line is 44 pixels tall.")}
    • ` line. Change nothing else on the page. 4. In `apps/web/static-pages.ts`, in the `PAGE_TEXT` `[paths.accessibility]` Known-gaps section, delete only the `"
  • With a mouse, the card names in the game log are closer together than 24 pixels; on a touch screen each line is 44 pixels tall.
    • " +` string. Note its list omits the deck-builder bullet the route has, so match by string, not by position. Leave every other section byte-identical. 5. In `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`, delete the entry whose key is `"With a mouse, the card names in the game log are closer together than 24 pixels; on a touch screen each line is 44 pixels tall."` (and its Chinese value). `i18n.test.ts` fails only on missing keys, so this deletion is safe; it just removes the orphan. 6. Run the verification commands in **Tests** below, in order, and fix only within the five files above if anything is red. ## Tests - New unit/stylesheet tests in `apps/web/src/game/Log.test.tsx`: the two `it(...)` cases named in step 2. They fail without the step-1 CSS (no `pointer: fine` block, no `min-height: 24px`) and pass with it; the coarse test fails if the 44 px block is disturbed. - Existing coverage, run unchanged: `apps/web/src/static-pages.test.ts` (its word-for-word quote test proves the route bullet and `PAGE_TEXT` were removed together), `apps/web/src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` (proves no translation key went missing), and the untouched `Log.test.tsx` suites (R745 history, announcer, inspect-sheet behavior prove keyboard, screen-reader and history behavior did not change). - Exact commands, each from the repository root: - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/Log.test.tsx` - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/static-pages.test.ts` - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` - `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/game/Log.test.tsx apps/web/src/routes/accessibility.tsx apps/web/static-pages.ts` - `cargo fmt --check` - Axe and pixel truth stay with the existing specs, run by CI, not by the builder: `e2e/cypress/e2e/38-accessibility.cy.ts` (axe over both boards at desktop size; expect no new violation) and `e2e/cypress/component/board-layout.cy.tsx` (board pixel budget). Do not edit or run them; jsdom cannot measure pixels, which is why the unit test asserts stylesheet text in the `Clock.test.tsx` style. ## Done when - [ ] On a fine pointer each card-naming log line exposes a hit target at least 24 px tall (new stylesheet test green). - [ ] On a coarse pointer each log line keeps its 44 px row (existing block untouched, coarse stylesheet test green). - [ ] The desktop log still looks like the same dense list (base `display: inline` retained; no 44 px rows on desktop) and still scrolls in its capped box with the newest line in view (`board.css` `.log`/`.log-line` and `Log.tsx` scroll logic untouched). - [ ] The accessibility page no longer lists the sub-24-pixel mouse spacing gap, in either the route or `PAGE_TEXT` (quote test green). - [ ] Keyboard, screen-reader and log-history behavior unchanged (existing `Log.test.tsx` suites green; `Log.tsx` unedited). - [ ] All commands in **Tests** pass; no ruling added and `cargo jackioh spec check` needs no run (nothing added or cited). ## Risks - `inline-block` rewraps a long card line inside the button instead of across the `li`. Mitigation: it still renders the same words on the same number of visual lines in the same position; the real-pixel guard is the existing board-layout Cypress spec in CI, and the plan adds no jsdom layout assertion that could fake-pass. - Devices whose primary pointer is fine but that also have touch get the 24 px rule rather than the 44 px rows. Mitigation: this follows the file's existing primary-pointer split (the coarse block already limits itself to `(pointer: coarse)` with the comment that a narrow mouse window keeps its old log), so behavior stays consistent with the established pattern. - Removing the bullet from only one of the route / `PAGE_TEXT` / `zh-CN.json` copies breaks the quote test or orphans a key. Mitigation: steps 3–5 name all three exact strings, and the static-pages test verifies the first two together. - A builder tempted to "fix" spacing in `board.css` (e.g. raising `.log-line` line-height or `.log` max-height) would change the dense look or the capped box. Mitigation: `board.css` is read-only in this plan; the 24 px `min-height` on the button already spaces card lines without touching shared list styles. ## Open questions None. Every choice the task left open is settled above (media-query placement and exact declarations, test style and names, all three copies of the bullet, no new constant, no ruling); the builder needs no person and no further decision. --- Comment by @MaxGoetzmann at 2026-11-20T13:58:45Z: Approve ````
